title: Gradle, the Wrapper, and Android Build Flow Quick Check

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the Gradle wrapper?
questions.explanation: Checked-in wrapper configuration gives local and CI builds the intended Gradle version.

questions.prompt: Order the broad Gradle build phases.
questions.explanation: Gradle discovers the build, configures its model, resolves requested inputs, and then executes required tasks.

questions.prompt: A dependency version written as 1.+ improves reproducible builds.
questions.explanation: Dynamic versions can resolve a different artifact without any source change.
